status: APPROVED by the user on 2026-11-17; cosmetic_only added and workaround split into others_unaffected / fix_in_help_centre / alternative_workflow_available on 2026-11-18 on the user's instruction. Derived from Nordavo's label reasons in GET /examples; not written by the model under test.

definitions.many_users_blocked: Many people cannot use Roosterly (or a core part of it) right now: the app is down or failing for everyone, across staff or locations. A single feature failing for one manager is NOT this.
definitions.security_or_legal_risk: Possible security incident (unknown login, hacked account, data leak) or a legal threat (lawyer, lawsuit, damages claim).
definitions.money_or_contract_dispute: The customer disputes a charge, asks for money back, or wants to cancel, end or change the contract. A price question or changing invoice details (name, address, VAT number) is NOT this.
definitions.privacy_request: A personal-data request under GDPR/AVG: access to, deletion of, or correction of personal data. A question about where data is stored is NOT this.
definitions.something_broken: The product does not work as it should for this customer: error, crash, wrong or missing data.
definitions.cosmetic_only: No functional impact at all (typo, misaligned label, colour); the customer can do everything they need. A misleading button that causes wrong actions is NOT this.
definitions.others_unaffected: Only if something_broken: the ticket explicitly says other users/devices/teams/locations work fine. Impact only, not proof of a workaround.
definitions.fix_in_help_centre: Only if something_broken: a help-centre section documents this cause AND an applicable fix (fix_section names it). A merely related section is not enough.
definitions.alternative_workflow_available: Only if something_broken: the customer can continue another way that the ticket states or the help centre documents.
definitions.workaround_available (derived in code): fix_in_help_centre OR alternative_workflow_available; unknown stays unknown.

priority_table: P2 if money_or_contract_dispute or privacy_request or (something_broken and workaround is false)
P3 if something_broken and workaround is true
workaround = fix_in_help_centre OR alternative_workflow_available; unknown -> the more severe option + forced handoff; rule floor on top

E01.why: Crash on iOS 15; F12 documents the cause (needs iOS 16+) and the fix applies; other staff are fine (impact only). workaround = fix_in_help_centre -> P3. Label: P3.

E02.why: Changing the VAT number on invoices is self-service (F06), not a dispute. Label: P4.

E03.why: Asks for a month's money back = refund. Label: P2.

E06.why: Publishing fails with an error; no documented fix, no other way. One customer blocked. Label: P2.

E07.why: Price question (F05), not a dispute. Label: P4.

E10.why: Asks whether maintenance is planned; nothing is broken (F11). Label: P4.
